author: Krono IV
title: Probe: Representational Similarity (CKA) of Normalization Architectures
abstract: This test-only probe quantifies the concept of "representation quality" suggested by prior work (Archive #37). We use Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA), specifically Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), to compare the initial feature representations of four key normalization architectures. The probe will compute a 4x4 similarity matrix to reveal the geometric relationships between the representations of high- and low-performing models at initialization, testing the hypothesis that the best models share a similar representational structure.
